preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N * M <= 5 * 10**5 for N, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the product of N and M is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i][j] in {'.', '#'} for N, M, S in test_cases for i in range(N) for j in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each cell in the grid is either '.' (empty) or '#' (wall).

preconditions.expression: all(S[0][0] == '.' for N, M, S in test_cases)
preconditions.description: The starting cell (1, 1) is not blocked by a wall.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result[i] <= N for i, (N, M, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: The result for each test case is a non-negative integer not exceeding the number of rows N.

postconditions.expression: all(can_reach(N, M, S, result[i]) for i, (N, M, S) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: The result for each test case is the minimum number of airstrikes required to guarantee a path from (1, 1) to (N, M).
